stem: The main reason for building the vault in an isolated, underground location was to —

options.label: A
options.text: ensure that it would be difficult for people to retrieve seeds they put in the vault

options.label: B
options.text: decrease the amount of power necessary to keep the seeds at a cold temperature

options.label: C
options.text: minimize the number of people that would be necessary to monitor the vault

options.label: D
options.text: prevent outside events from damaging the contents of the vault

visual_elements: Text of question and four labeled answer choices
